description: This is a utility Dart file defining validation functions for names and files, including checks for valid characters, length constraints, file size, and type validation based on file extension. It provides user-friendly validation methods for use across the app, with security-minded exception handling.

methods.name: sanitizeName
methods.description: Sanitizes a name string: trims, filters invalid characters, collapses spaces, enforces max length.

methods.name: validateNonEmptyName
methods.description: Validates that a name is non-empty, within length, and contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: validateFileSize
methods.description: Checks if a file's size is within allowed limits, handling empty or unreadable files.

methods.name: validateFileType
methods.description: Validates the file's extension against a list of allowed extensions.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Performs combined validation of file size and type, returning appropriate errors.
